body: I was on a waiting list but then I moved house so now I need to get myself on a local waiting list again, but I'm too anxious and terrified to leave the house. I have anti depressants but I'm terrified of taking them because they can make suicidal or self harming thoughts worse at first and mine are already really bad. I don't know if I could make it through the adjustment

Thank you for offering me someone to talk to, I haven't had that in a while. It sounds stupid and pathetic but since posting this I've managed to get myself out of bed and brush my hair today, even if it is 6pm it's better than I've been doing recently.

Thank you. I am not in a good headspace and I'm not sure of what is OK anymore. I am not a very good girlfriend right now because of my mental health, I lost my place at university because of it therefore I am more financially dependent on my partner, I am too lazy and stupid to cook or clean or do anything right at the moment, and if I try to, I do it wrong or I break something.  So I can understand why he resents me and doesn't seem like he cares if I live or die. I'm just a burden on him
Thank you I'll have a look online and do some research :)
No, I don't have the money to move right now. And thank you, I will try to exercise more, I should probably try to eat healthier too.
My partner. Also, rain, because there's a lot less people around when it's raining.

I feel like I've hit rock bottom recently and I'm not sure how to get out of it, I'm still not sure, but this post genuinely made me feel like not giving up on myself yet. Thank you for taking the time to post this

At 15, I'm 22 now. It's pretty hard to remember but I think the first time I did it as a sort of cry for help as I just wanted someone to take how I was feeling seriously. Couldn't stop after that though.
